sample_unit: clinical images of nail disease cases

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of multimodal LLMs versus dermatologists on the same nail images (SD and SD+DD)
links.effect: Dermatologists correct in 70.6% (SD) and 80.3% (SD+DD); AI models correct in 25.0% (SD) and 35.0% (SD+DD), p<0.001.
links.quote: In comparison, AI models were correct in 25.0% (95% CI: 16.8-35.5) and 35.0% (95% CI: 25.5-45.9) of cases, respectively (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study conducts a comparative reader study assessing the diagnostic accuracy of dermatologists versus multimodal LLMs on nail disease images; it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
